_comment: The format of YOUR review cycle's self-reflection. The self-review skill drafts one block per section, in this order. Edit the sections, prompts and word budgets to match your company's tool. Fernhill example (half-year check-in).
name: Fernhill half-year self-reflection
cadence: Mid-year and end-of-year (set your own months)

sections.title: What went well
sections.prompt: What are you proudest of, and what changed because of it? Include the values paragraph.

sections.title: What was hard
sections.prompt: One real challenge, what you learned, what you would do differently.

sections.title: Looking ahead
sections.prompt: Focus areas for the next half, tied to your objectives.

sections.title: Anything else
sections.prompt: Context the manager needs. Leave out if empty.
